baseline_checks.note: Must run under the node that npm lifecycle scripts resolve (nvm v24.0.2), because package.json test:release invokes a bare `node`. Verifying under /opt/homebrew/bin/node v25.9.0 false-fails with canonical_test_proof_node_version_mismatch.

capture_events.what: sks align run executed unintentionally during baseline capture, via an unescaped backtick in a double-quoted shell string that became command substitution.
capture_events.effect: The context graph went from stale (dirty_fingerprint_changed, snapshot c822c0c4, 24480 nodes / 64334 edges, generated 2026-08-07) to fresh (snapshot a001a5ba, 25637 nodes / 67204 edges). Two tracked generated artifacts were rewritten: .sneakoscope/wiki/code-navigation-manifest.json and .sneakoscope/wiki/code-pack.json. No source file, no commit, and no branch pointer was touched; HEAD stayed at base_sha.
capture_events.disposition: Kept rather than reverted. git checkout of the two tracked files would restore the pre-align manifest while leaving the regenerated snapshot on disk, which the store reads back as meta_mismatch/corrupt. The resulting fresh graph is also the state the Atlas work needs. The two modified tracked files must land as their own commit before Wave 1 source changes.
capture_events.recorded_because: The work order requires the baseline to disclose rather than hide what happened during capture.

known_preexisting_failures.note: The active graph predated the 8.3.3 commit, so the work order's observed counts (2734 files / 20734 symbols / 64334 edges) described the 2026-08-07 snapshot, not base_sha. Resolved by the unplanned align run recorded in capture_events. Atlas preflight must still exercise its stale path (in-memory overlay) rather than assuming a fresh graph, because this condition recurs on every source edit.

architecture:check is the only real file-size budget enforcement and runs solely in .github/workflows/publish-npm.yml. A green release DAG proves nothing about budgets, so Atlas files must be budget-checked explicitly rather than assumed covered.

working_tree_note: Two tracked generated artifacts are modified by the align run recorded in capture_events. No source file is modified.
